svg.aria-label: Delivered code does not say what runs; an observed run shows it line by line, with the time spent and the real values.

g.text: What the code does not say, the run shows
Dynamic analysis: observing the application while it runs, without modifying its code or its build.
No recompilation, no instrumentation of the
source code, no licence, no network.
and what never runs — hence what can be removed
Where the time goes, method by method
the hot loop, not the one suspected
the real parameters, not the documented ones
A measured answer, in a few minutes.
